projects.name: GE Vernova and TIC Project Development Agreement gas-fired combined cycle generation projects
projects.quote: On February 13, 2025, NRG signed a strategic Project Development Agreement with GE Vernova (“GEV”) and Kiewit’s subsidiary, TIC, to develop and construct up to 5.4 GW of new gas-fired, combined cycle generation projects.

projects.name: GEV slot reservation agreement for 7HA gas turbines
projects.quote: Additionally, NRG has entered into a slot reservation agreement with GEV for the procurement of 1.2 GW of 7HA gas turbines.

projects.name: Renew Home VPP portfolio
projects.quote: Leveraging Google Cloud’s AI and cloud platforms, NRG and Renew Home plan to develop a VPP portfolio of up to 1 GW of load management capacity, with instantaneous dispatch value during peak events and tight supply conditions.
